svg.aria-label: The same gesture at hex size 20 — a wider hex crawl on the same screen area. The brush is hex-sized in both figures, so the staircase is always about one hex deep; what changes is how many hexes the region spans, and at 20 the same artefact reads as roughness rather than as blocks.

g.text: (b) the same drag, written as whole hexes
(b) with (a) overlaid — exactly what is lost
